draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.92, the 167th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 22nd of 37 at CB. He went 108th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (167th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Tye Smith. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 passes defended in 2020, 12th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 48 career games and 12 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2022. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 12.9% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, below the norm.
